title: Number of Islands

monster.name: Archipelago Golem
monster.title: Lord of Isolated Archipelagos
monster.defeatQuote: Disconnected land masses in the endless ocean counted!

description: Given an `m x n` 2D binary grid `grid` which represents a map of `'1'`s (land) and `'0'`s (water), return the number of islands. An island is surrounded by water and is formed by connecting adjacent lands horizontally or vertically.
hints: Iterate every cell. When '1' is found, increment island count and DFS/BFS sink all adjacent '1's.
